homebrew.description: Renovate's homebrew manager reads our formula fine, but when it writes a new url it only tries '<repo>-<semver>.tar.gz' (which we do not publish) and the '/archive/refs/tags/' source archive (which does not contain releasetools.bash, since dist/ is gitignored upstream). Either way it would pair a valid sha256 with the wrong file and break bin.install. .github/workflows/bump-formula.yml does the bump against the real release asset instead.
